content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: Fires when abioc `Cloud Unusual Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) access` and xql `Suspicious usage of EC2 token` both observe the SAME EC2 instance role session (assumed-role ARN + instance_id) within the run window — stitching the off-instance instance-profile credential use and the off-instance EC2-token write into one incident. The shared entity is the instance-profile role session (role_session_name == instance_id); the pivot is the divergence of the session's source IP from the instance's own egress.
rules.name: SIM-CDR-023 IMDS token theft to remote use stitch
